Name: Game Achievements Thank you letters - Translation Pack QLS
Author: 17SunAndMoon17
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#4D79FF]Game Achievements Thank You Letters - Translation Pack QLS
[/color][/b][/size][size=4][color=#A3A3A3]High-Quality Translations for the "Game Achievements Thank You Letters" Mod[/color][/size][/center]
[b]Translation Pack QLS[/b] (Quality Language & Support) is a project dedicated to making great Stardew Valley mods accessible to more players around the world.
This pack adds high-quality translations to the wonderful "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30184]Game Achievements Thank You Letters[/url]" mod.
[size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
About the Base Mod[/color][/b][/size]
The original mod makes your in-game achievements feel more rewarding. When you unlock an achievement, a villager will send you a letter to congratulate you, often with a small gift included! It makes the world of Stardew Valley feel more alive and responsive to your progress.

[size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]Languages Added in this Pack:[/color][/b][/size]
This QLS Pack provides community translations for the following languages:
[list]
[*]German (de)
[*]Spanish (es)
[*]Italian (it)
[*]Korean (ko)
[*]Polish (pl)
[*]Portuguese (pt)
[/list]
[color=yellow][i](Note: The base mod already includes English, Chinese, French, Japanese, and Russian).[/i][/color]
[size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Requirements
[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The original [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30184]Game Achievements Thank you letters[/url][/b] mod.
[/list]
[color=orange][b]Please ensure the base mod and its dependencies are working correctly *before* installing this translation pack.
[/b][/color][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Installation
[/color][/b][/size]
[color=red][b]
!! IMPORTANT: YOU MUST INSTALL THE ORIGINAL MOD *FIRST* !!
[/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30184]original mod[/url] and its dependencies.
[*]Download this pack's file from the [b]"Files"[/b] tab.
[*]Unzip the download and copy the "[CP] Game Achievements Thank You Letters" folder.
[*]Paste the folder into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" directory. Your computer [b]WILL[/b] ask if you want to merge folders and replace files. You [b][color=red]MUST[/color][/b] select [color=red][b]YES / MERGE / REPLACE ALL[/b][/color].
[*]Play.
[/list][size=5][b][color=#80BFFF]
Credits & Compatibility
[/color][/b][/size]
This pack only contains translation files and does not alter any game mechanics.
Full credit for the core mod belongs to its original author, [b]sadnumbme[/b]. Please support their work by visiting the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30184]original mod page[/url] and leaving an endorsement!
Translations provided by the [b]Translation Pack QLS[/b] team.
